items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: In fact I worked with Spencer recently down in Princeton

ctx.x: But I think he says quite strongly here that his baritone playing evolved out of his bass sax playing -- it sounds to me very much like a bass saxophone.

Yeah, I think it was a bass saxophone, it was too big for a baritone sax. In fact I worked with Spencer recently down in Princeton and it is definitely a bass sax that he had. Unless maybe he had a baritone sax on this date.
